fields.why: Table 1 gives mortality and adjusted RRs for four race groups and six age groups, and Table 2 SMRs for four race/ethnicity groups, discussed as 'especially pronounced in Asian and Hispanic/Latino populations'.
Race/ethnicity and age each have 3+ groups with an outcome per group; sex and Hispanic ethnicity alone are pairs.

Poisson RRs against White and against ages 10-34 are per-group vs referent; the race/ethnicity SMRs (each vs its own general population) are compared across groups with no test, which is side by side. The flag concerns a paraphrased table quote ('Race › Black, 1.5 (1.1–2.3)'), not the value, which the CSV supports.
